JUNIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER
VS CA NORCO, Norco, CA, US
30+ days ago
Requisition ID: 1589
Apply
Salary Range:
$25.00 To $41.00 Hourly

*This is a 100% on-site position in Norco, CA*

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Full Stack Developer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for recent graduates or professionals with 1–2 years of software development experience eager to expand their technical expertise across both front-end and back-end development.

The ideal candidate is passionate about learning, enjoys solving technical challenges, and thrives in a collaborative, mentorship-focused environment. This position offers an opportunity to work with modern web technologies while gaining hands-on experience with enterprise applications and data-driven solutions.

Responsibilities

Build responsive, user-friendly UI components using HTML5, CSS3, React, and JavaScript/TypeScript. Optimize applications for usability and performance.
Assist in building and maintaining server-side applications, REST APIs, and backend services using C#/.NET.
Work with PostgreSQL databases for data storage and query optimization; support the integration of dashboards and data visualization tools.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Participate in testing, debugging, and code reviews.
Utilize Git for version control and Jira for task tracking. Active participation in Agile/Scrum team ceremonies.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent internship/project experience).
1–2 years of academic, internship, or professional experience with React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong foundational understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
Academic exposure to or familiarity with C# / .NET and PostgreSQL (or relational databases).
Familiarity with Git version control and basic Agile concepts.
Excellent communication skills and a strong desire to learn from senior developers.
US Citizenship required
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance
If applicable: If you are or have been recently employed by the U.S. government, a post-employment ethics letter will be required if employment is offered 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Vite, Vue.js, or additional front-end frameworks.
Familiarity with Jira and Agile project management tools.
Exposure to SAFe Agile or Agile methodologies and team environments.
Understanding of relational database concepts and SQL queries.
Familiarity with cloud platforms or deployment workflows.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Personal, academic, or open-source development projects.

Company Summary

Join the VSolvit Team! Founded in 2006, VSolvit (pronounced 'We Solve It') is a technology services provider that specializes in cybersecurity, cloud computing, geographic information systems (GIS), business intelligence (BI) systems, data warehousing, engineering services, and custom database and application development. VSolvit is an award winning WOSB, CA CDB, MBE, WBE, and CMMI Level 3 certified company. We offer a customizable health benefits program that best meets the needs of its employees. Offering may include: medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, long and short-term disability and other insurance products, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, 401K Retirement Plan options, Tuition Reimbursement, and assorted voluntary benefits. Our goal is to grow together and enjoy the work that we do as a team.

VSolvit LLC is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
